decisions.decision: Sparkle SPM auto-embeds via packageProductDependencies on macOS app target — DO NOT add manual PBXCopyFilesBuildPhase Embed Frameworks
decisions.rationale: Plan 06-02 deviation: Task 1 initial manual copy phase tried to copy non-existent 'Sparkle' (no .framework suffix) from Build/Products/Debug/ and broke build; removed and Xcode 16 auto-embedded correctly

decisions.decision: Use defer { checkAndWarnPermissions() } in ConfigStore.load() rather than tail-position call
decisions.rationale: Fires through any early-return paths — strictly stronger than the plan's prescription, no downside

decisions.decision: ci.yml plutil extract uses backslash-escaped dotted key form 'com\.apple\.security\.network\.client'
decisions.rationale: plutil treats . as nested-keypath separator; bare 'com.apple.security.network.client' returns 'No value at that key path'. Plan 06-04 verify line had this bug; ci.yml fix includes inline gotcha comment

decisions.decision: release.yml comments avoid literal forbidden tokens (--deep, altool)
decisions.rationale: Plan's negative-grep gates match literal tokens anywhere in file including comments; reworded as 'codesign recursive-deep-sign flag' / 'deprecated pre-notarytool submission CLI'

D-08 + REL-09 — only entitlement is com.apple.security.network.client; no disable-library-validation/allow-jit/allow-dyld-environment-variables added (Sparkle 2.x on Hardened Runtime + non-sandbox does not require them)
Apple's actual export-options key; the typo would silently disable Hardened Runtime in the export step
